subject: Workday invite accepted but account linking stalls — duplicate vendor identity causing PO hold
messages:
From: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@nimbleworks.com>
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.example.com
Cc: procure@nimbleworks.com
Date: Fri, 04 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: NimbleWorks onboarding — accepted invite, account linking fails

Hi Sergio,

We accepted the Workday supplier invite this morning (thank you). Progressed through the form but when we try to link our bank account the portal returns a generic error and the "Connect bank" step never completes. The UI shows our vendor listed twice under slightly different legal names (one with a DBA). The result is that the PO I tried to pull into our system is still on hold. Can you confirm whether duplicate vendor identities will block PO release?

I've attached our filled vendor form and a W-9 for reference. Also attaching a short screen recording link in Drive.

Attachments: nimble_vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (application/pdf), W9_NimbleWorks.pdf (application/pdf)

Thanks — appreciate a quick look, we have an upcoming shipment on Monday and need PO visibility.

Best,
Aisha Patel
Senior Procurement, NimbleWorks Inc
A: procure@nimbleworks.com | M: +1 (415) 555-0132

From: sergio_alvarez@redwood.example.com
To: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@nimbleworks.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.example.com, marissa_cole@redwood.example.com
Date: Fri, 04 Dec 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: NimbleWorks onboarding — accepted invite, account linking fails

Hi Aisha — thanks for the details and the attachments. Looping in Ben (sales ops) and Marissa (onboarding lead) to help. Quick answers up front:

- Duplicate vendor records can cause the account-link flow to hang if the portal tries to reconcile a legacy profile.
- We should be able to lift the PO hold after we confirm canonical vendor mapping and bank verification.

Ben/Marissa — can you check whether there are two vendor records for NimbleWorks (one under "NimbleWorks LLC" and another under "NimbleWorks, dba NW Supply") and if so, advise on a safe merge path that preserves the pending PO and bank details? Aisha attached the forms; the Drive recording is here: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aBcdExample

I'll start a ticket with Platform (SRE) if you need any debug logs from the portal — happy to pull them.

Thanks,
Sergio Alvarez
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.example.com

From: ben_carter@redwood.example.com
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.example.com, marissa_cole@redwood.example.com
Cc: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@nimbleworks.com>
Date: Fri, 04 Dec 2026 12:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: NimbleWorks onboarding — accepted invite, account linking fails

Thanks for the tag, Sergio. I pulled the supplier index and confirm two vendor rows:

- vendor_id 7a4b2c (NimbleWorks LLC) — created 2025-10-02
- vendor_id 9f0d1e (NimbleWorks (dba NW Supply)) — created 2026-11-30

Both have a pending PO (PO-99877) attached, but only 9f0d1e has a bank object. The portal's bank-link job is referencing 7a4b2c which lacks bank data, hence the hang.

Recommended next steps (proposed):
1) Marissa to confirm which legal entity NimbleWorks wants as canonical (they've said LLC in the form).
2) We merge 9f0d1e into 7a4b2c and reassign the bank object.
3) Run a quick bank verification job; once the verification webhook succeeds we can clear the PO hold.

Marissa — can you run the merge in sandbox and confirm a no-downtime plan for production? If there are any PII concerns we escalate to SecOps.

Attachments: portal_debug_instructions.txt (text/plain)

—Ben
Ben Carter
Sales Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@nimbleworks.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.example.com, sergio_alvarez@redwood.example.com
Cc: procure@nimbleworks.com
Date: Sat, 05 Dec 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: NimbleWorks onboarding — accepted invite, account linking fails

Thanks Ben / Sergio — NimbleWorks confirms canonical name is "NimbleWorks LLC". We prefer not to share additional PII beyond the W-9 already attached.

I've tried the bank verification twice and captured the portal error console output; uploaded the logs here and shared with your team: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aBcdExample (see portal_debug_log.txt). We also completed the DocuSign flow for updated vendor terms; signing link: https://docusign.net/Signing/?t=xyz123

Can you confirm an ETA to merge the profiles and whether the PO hold will be cleared before Monday's shipment?

—Aisha

From: marissa_cole@redwood.example.com
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.example.com, ben_carter@redwood.example.com
Cc: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@nimbleworks.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Dec 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: NimbleWorks onboarding — accepted invite, account linking fails

Hi team — I tested the merge in sandbox (steps below) and it looks clean:

- Sandbox merge completed: vendor 9f0d1e -> 7a4b2c, bank object moved, PO relationships preserved.
- No extra audit table rows were dropped; we retained created_by metadata.
- After merge I triggered the bank verification job and saw success (simulated in sandbox).

Production plan:
- Schedule maintenance window at 10:00 PM PST tonight to run the merge; will take ~15 minutes.
- Post-merge, we will re-trigger the production bank verification webhook and monitor for success.

If Aisha confirms approval for the maintenance window, we'll proceed and then remove the PO hold (PO-99877) as soon as verification completes. If SecOps wants to review the audit trail before the merge, please advise now — otherwise we'll proceed with the window.

Attachments: portal_debug_log.txt (application/text)

Marissa Cole
Onboarding Lead, Redwood Inference
